headline: US warships will NEVER be allowed into the Persian Gulf 'under any circumstances'
dek: Abdollahi: 'We will not allow US military ships in the Persian Gulf under any circumstances and at any time'; 'The US president must dream of seeing the armed forces enter the Persian Gulf. He will take that dream to his grave'; Iran's armed forces have 'rendered the US Navy ineffective'.
sources: Maj. Gen. Ali Abdollahi, Chief of Staff of the Iranian Armed Forces (statement via Iranian state television; carried by Mehr/PressTV/Pars Today/Tasnim); Tom Barrack interview with Mario Nawfal (Oct 23)
fault_line: Iran says the Gulf is closed to the US Navy 'forever' while Trump says America is 'taking all the oil out that we want' — who actually controls the Gulf now?

sections.what_happened: Abdollahi: 'We will not allow US military ships in the Persian Gulf under any circumstances and at any time'; 'The US president must dream of seeing the armed forces enter the Persian Gulf. He will take that dream to his grave'; Iran's armed forces have 'rendered the US Navy ineffective'. Barrack (US ambassador to Turkiye): 'Is a weekend strike possible? Absolutely.' Jahanshahi (Iranian Army Ground Forces commander, via Tasnim Friday): units to maintain highest combat readiness.
sections.what_verified: Abdollahi statement carried by Iranian state-media ecosystem (Mehr, PressTV, Pars Today, Al Mayadeen quoting Tasnim/IRIB); New Indian Express (aggregator, AP file photo) reports the same quotes 06:11. Barrack quote reported by jawawa.id. No Western wire yet carries the Abdollahi statement in this scan's retrieval.
sections.what_disputed: Trump (South Lawn, Friday): 'We are getting everything we want' / 'we're taking all the oil out that we want' — contradicts 'Gulf closed' framing; Hormuz is an international strait and the exclusion claim applies to the Persian Gulf beyond it; US actual naval posture unknown (unverifiable from public sources).
sections.why_matters: On-camera threat from Iran's top commander stacked against the 'absolutely' weekend-strike threat — the Persian Gulf is now a named red line, days after Iran mined the tanker lanes. Pocketbook hook: this is the line Brent prices live or die on.
sections.context: Background: NEW (big-missed; statement Saturday Oct 24) -- Iran armed forces chief of staff Ali Abdollahi: US warships will NEVER be allowed into the Persian Gulf 'under any circumstances'; Trump will 'take that dream to his grave'; Tom Barrack: US strike 'as soon as this weekend' 'absolutely' possible

totw_analysis: Our read: On-camera threat from Iran's top commander stacked against the 'absolutely' weekend-strike threat — the Persian Gulf is now a named red line, days after Iran mined the tanker lanes. Pocketbook hook: this is the line Brent prices live or die on. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Iran says the Gulf is closed to the US Navy 'forever' while Trump says America is 'taking all the oil out that we want' — who actually controls the Gulf now?
